description: List PENDING ask_operator queries on a phone mission (or all of an agent's missions when id is omitted). Use this BEFORE assuming a verification-style message from the operator is a fresh chat question — if there's an open query, the operator is most likely answering it. Pair with call_answer_query to inject the answer.

_account.description: Optional. Override identity for THIS call: pass the AgenticMail agent name (e.g. "Fola") to authenticate as that agent. Requires AGENTICMAIL_ACCOUNT_KEYS_JSON to contain a matching key. Omit to use the default identity (AGENTICMAIL_API_KEY).

id.description: Phone mission id. Omit to scan all of your agent's missions for open queries.

name: call_open_queries
